messages:
maria: heads up — noticed a weirdness in staging: when ingress preempts a long streaming request and the upstream does an early-flush + retry, we sometimes end up with duplicate partial responses and double billing for overlapping tokens.
alex: hmm, can you paste a quick repro trace?
maria: yeah, repro attached in thread (trimmed):
```
Ingress: client -> edge (stream start)
Edge: route to upstream-A
Upstream-A: emits partial chunk, then early-flush (connection close)
Edge: marks stream as PREEMPTED, proxies trailers, attempts fallback to upstream-B
Upstream-B: resumes from last commit token but also the early-flush chunks were forwarded again
Client: sees repeated chunks
```

sam: is the issue that we forward the early-flush payload while also replaying the same tokens from KV resume?
maria: exactly. We forward whatever bytes arrived before the upstream TCP close, then the resume handshake requests the last-checkpoint token, and upstream-B replays starting a few tokens earlier. Edge merges both naively.
jordan: that's painful. we should pick one canonical source-of-truth per replay: either forwarded bytes or resumed tokens. Do we have a flag currently?
maria: there's a per-stream state bit we set temporarily (FORWARDED_UNCOMMITTED) when we forward an early-chunk. But the resume path ignores it because resume is handled by a different codepath.
katie: could we teach the resume codepath to consult that bit and issue a trim offset to upstream-B? e.g., send Resume-Offset header with the number of bytes already emitted?
alex: that would require upstream models/endpoints to accept resume offsets — some do, some don't. We also have models that only accept token checkpoints, not raw byte offsets.
infra-bot: deploy check — edge-side header negotiation for resume-offset is behind flag `edge.resume_offset_header` on staging.
maria: proposal: make the edge state machine authoritative and add a short-lived reservation token. Flow: on early-flush, mark FORWARDED and emit a reservation id to the client trace. When routing to fallback, include `X-Edge-Reservation: <id>` and `X-Edge-Resume-Mode: checkpoint|replay` — upstreams that understand it will trim replayed tokens; upstreams that don't will return 409/RESUME_MISMATCH and edge can choose to drop forwarded bytes or drop the resumed stream (configurable policy).
sam: sounds robust. tradeoffs: increases handshake surface and makes preemption slightly heavier. also we need to ensure we don't convert a transient network dup into side-effect duplication for endpoints that have non-idempotent side effects.
jordan: plus we need metrics: how often reservation mismatch occurs, bytes-trimmed, duplicate-token events (billing impact).
katie: fallback policy idea: default to prefer forwarded-bytes for sub-2s windows since client already saw them; prefer resume for >2s windows where resume saves cost. Make threshold tunable per-tenant.
alex: agree. Also we should avoid blocking binary compatibility: implement the headers as opt-in and have edge fallback policy to 'safe-drop' — on mismatch, keep only the earliest-seen sequence and ignore replayed tokens. We should log a high-fidelity event for forensics.
maria: implementation checklist I sketched:
- add reservation id to stream state (UUID)
- emit `X-Edge-Reservation` & `X-Edge-Resume-Mode` on fallback request
- resume codepath to consult FORWARDED flag and apply trim when upstream supports header
- on upstream 409 -> follow tenant policy: prefer-forwarded (drop resumed) or prefer-resume (drop forwarded and re-emit from upstream)
- add metrics + alert if duplicates > 0.1% of streams

Would anyone object to me turning this into a short RFC and a staging flag?
sam: +1, please include ops playbook for incidents where mismatch spikes (rollback flag, force-prefers).
jordan: +1. also list exact header names and wire format (compact base64 token for reservation).
katie: +1 from me; can help with the metrics dashboard layout.
alex: +1. pls note backward compatibility path for older upstreams in the RFC.
infra-bot: rfc-draft created: /rfc/edge/resume-reservation-2026-03-23 (draft). status: staging-flag suggested.
maria: thanks all — will draft RFC and ping owners for review. :thumbsup:
